cost: cover expected O(A+S) time and O(S) pool references, removing O(content) temporary Vec. try_doubt costs answer callback plus each anchor callback/cover; duplicate anchors retain repeated callbacks.
description: Annotate forms/lemmas, classify content words, compute per-anchor content coverage and select first maximum meeting DOUBT=0.8.
forward: Annotate forms/lemmas, classify content words, compute per-anchor content coverage and select first maximum meeting DOUBT=0.8.
inverse: Ratio 1 admits any covered answer with arbitrarily repeated content tokens; ratio 0 admits disjoint pools. Winner index/ratio cannot reconstruct annotation or losing anchors.
limitations: Finite synthetic fixtures, partial syntax projection.
No numerical surrogate or live teacher/model/database/corpus tests; multi-file writes remain nontransactional.
state: cover None iff no answer content words, otherwise ratio in [0,1]. try_doubt validates all anchor bounds before callbacks; valid ties preserve first anchor.
